## Annex3toFormofAgreement

## PriceAdjustment Formulasfor theBasicItems

The Parties hereby acknowledge and agree that they are fully aware of the current and potentialeconomiccircumstancesprevailing in theCountry,includingbutnot limited to inflation, fluctuations in and devaluation of the local currency value, and macroeconomic changes that may impact the financial stability of the Contract.

Accordingly, the Parties have mutually agreed upon the formula and adjustment mechanism as outlined herein, which is expressly designed to account for any increases or decreases in the value of the local currency throughout the duration of the Contract.This adjustment mechanismshall be appliedconsistentlyand transparently as per the relevant terms and conditions of Contract,and the Parties acknowledge and agree that by applying these formulae,provided that all conditions precedent for such equitable.

The Parties further confirm that this formula serves as the sole means of currency value adjustment under this Contract,and no additional claims related tocurrencyfluctuations shall be entertained unless otherwise expressly provided for in the Contract.

This acknowledgment and adjustment mechanism are integral to the Contract and are acceptedbybothPartiesasfair,reasonable,andreflectiveofthemutualunderstanding oftheeconomicenvironmentatthetimeofexecution.

The following addition/omission to the Contract Sum as resulted from the adjustment formulas below shall be applicable and shall not be considered within the variation percentage in accordance with Clause 22.

The adjustment Calculation for the below formulas shall be conducted on monthly base. The addition/omission amounts resulting from such adjustment calculation will be releaseorcollectedeverymonth.

To the extent that full compensation for rise or fall in Costs is not covered by the provisions/formulas of the Agreement,the adjustment considered by theAgreement formulas,shallbedeemedtohaveincludedamountstocoverthecontingencyofother rises and falls in costs, where no further adjustment shall be applied and/or considered.

IncasetheContractorfailstocomplete theWorkswithintheContractperiod/Timefor the Contractor by the Employer pursuant to the provisions of Contract, adjustment of prices/rates considered by the agreement formulas, if any, shall be made using either expiry of the Contract Period/ Time for completion of the Works or (i) the current index or price, whichever is more favorable to the Employer.

## A.USD Currency Exchange Rate:

In case the rate of exchange for the USD selling rate announced by the Central Bankof Egypt at the date of payment certificate submittal(without any commissions
